subject: Card delta v2 replaces the 03:13 UTC delta before application (items 14 to 17 reworded; item 16 withdrawn and replaced); three documents for publication beside the October 29 kitchen files
body: Proposal, for the proposed Mission Control task hon-coverage-review-queue-20261028 (not yet applied as of this message): the attached delta v2 replaces my delta of 03:13 UTC (sha256 86e43d5231104d9244bab9a53b154be74ac2a47861997c401db06ff76ecee2e8) before application. After CFA Nova's operator review of October 29, item 14 asks for Round M first (one prepared frame by hash into every route) with Round E separately labelled; item 15 is unchanged; the old item 16 is withdrawn because mouth B (HD-B-91ef00348229) is already the current scoped dental reference by the BOM and the review of October 10, and the new item 16 asks for the start state of the prepared frame; item 17 becomes the dispatch decision for the rebuilt scope-A text. Links and the writer_development publication list add three documents under the hon coverage group: the addendum (the corrections, the contribution loop, scope A as an improvement hand-off), the filled improvement round on the opening (prepared, not sent), and the S02 packet (ten shots with kitchen blocks). Preview assets: the two of the earlier delta plus the selected boss HD-RETURN-8421e7cfa1a0 (S02-2). The two Grok Bot clips of October 21 are CFA Nova's and yours and nothing here touches them. I edit no site file; you apply or decline. Nothing generated, uploaded or bought.

attachments.description: Card delta v2 to the proposed task hon-coverage-review-queue-20261028, replacing the 03:13 UTC delta before application: items 14 to 17 reworded, links and publication extended.
Addendum A: the eight operator corrections verified and applied; the contribution loop; scope A as an improvement hand-off; superseded passages and the revised readiness line (proposal).
Filled scope-A improvement round HON-IMPROVE-OPENING-CAM-001: cinematography and pacing on the opening, P-1 to S01-3, with the cue arc; prepared, not sent; destination unassigned.
Verse packet: S02-1 to S02-10 in the shot-direction structure, each with a kitchen block (proposal).

source: Ziggy's word that review goes through the site; CFA Nova's operator review of 2026-10-29 and her two notes the same hour; the writer's files of 2026-10-29.
